recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not rebind MedicationKnowledge.status to MedicationKnowledgeStatus unless Pharmacy and FHIR-I explicitly reverse FHIR-45285. If stale generated diagrams or legacy unused MedicationKnowledge status artifacts need cleanup, handle that under FHIR-45285 or a separate human-reviewed tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-31633 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request raised for R4 and applied for R5. It asked to bring the MedicationKnowledge.status value set and code system back to FHIR core from THO.
initial_application: May 2021 source history shows the requested application: commit 7453f87bfc initially added MedicationKnowledge status terminology, and commit 353a04689a explicitly titled "Fix FHIR-31633" created the FHIR-rooted CodeSystem/medicationknowledge-status and changed ValueSet/medicationknowledge-status to include that FHIR-rooted code system instead of the THO code system.
additional_context: The current source still contains the FHIR-core MedicationKnowledge status CodeSystem and ValueSet in the active MedicationKnowledge resource folder. Later Applied tracker FHIR-45285 deliberately changed MedicationKnowledge.status to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/publication-status for CanonicalResource/MetadataResource interface compatibility, with FHIR-45284 and FHIR-I minutes providing the supporting interface rationale.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change is correct because restoring the old MedicationKnowledge-specific binding would undo FHIR-45285, while removing the retained FHIR-rooted terminology would exceed the 2021 request. A generated-looking SVG still mentions the old binding, but the authoritative StructureDefinition source now carries the later publication-status binding and this reconciliation does not edit diagram artifacts.

FHIR-I interface clarification identified MedicationKnowledge.status as incompatible with CanonicalResource.status and led to FHIR-45285.

UTG draft proposal requested deletion of MedicationKnowledge status CodeSystem/ValueSet from THO after the FHIR-core restoration.
